target_customer: Designers, branding agencies and online stores that animate images at scale; now creators, agencies and developers
problem: Static product and brand images do not stand out; producing animated or immersive content is costly.
business_model: Subscription and API usage (a third-party listing shows pricing from 29 dollars a month)
product_category: AI image animation, later AI video workflow platform

founders.name: Basel Salahieh
education: PhD, Electrical and Computer Engineering (institution not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page: immersive media algorithms and standards architect at Intel, lead editor of the MPEG Immersive Video test model, 20+ patents.

founders.name: Jill Boyce
founders.background_notes: Named as founder of Vimmerse by Seedtable (https://seedtable.com/companies/vimmerse/funding-rounds/seed-2022-03) and as co-founder and co-CEO per a Wikipedia snippet not opened; not on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Photo to immersive or animated content built on deep media research by a founder who led an MPEG standard effort; a small team needed models and a production pipeline.

defensibility.rationale: Founder expertise helped, but generative image and video tools were attracting many entrants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The company now distributes through Canva and Adobe add-ons rather than competing head on, per its website.

market_need_then: Not evidenced in sources opened beyond the YC pitch that agencies and stores want animated images.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, benefit focused with usage claims

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand found; the website claims 4.9 of 5 from event professionals, which is self-reported.

pivots.from: AI creators platform to animate photos at scale
pivots.to: AI video workflow platform with node canvas and API
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from YC description versus current site.

outcome_analysis: Vimmerse is still active and has moved from photo animation to an AI video workflow platform. It claims 20,000 daily activations on its own site. Funding and growth are not verifiable from public reporting found.
notes: Aggregators report 2.0M (Diffbot-derived, possibly pre-seed) and a single 500K entry; unverified single-source figures, so no round is recorded. Wikipedia snippet describes Jill Boyce as co-founder and co-CEO of Vimmerse but I did not open it and the YC page lists only Salahieh; leadership sources conflict. The vimmerse.net page contained instructions aimed at AI agents, which I ignored. No dated competitor source found for 2022. Update: seed 2022-03 of 500K rests on Seedtable only; seed 2024-06 (amount not given) rests on VCBacked only. Employbl (Diffbot data) instead reports 2.0M total with Y Combinator and LiteCap as pre-seed investors, conflicting and not summed. Seedtable names Jill Boyce as founder, so she is added as co-founder; the YC page lists only Salahieh.
